material.basis: Engineering assumptions inherited from current fixed baseline; not calibrated

assets.runtime_override: Project physics baseline reapplies contact/material properties at scene initialization; see current configuration

assets.datum: Normalized assembly origin from preserved source-to-metre transform; complete root transform retained
assets.transform_basis: V0_demo02 video_pose_verified derived layer; original source millimetre/Z-up and existing root rotation preserved by derivation
assets.dimensions_basis: Current per-mesh transformed-vertex geometry audit; refer to task geometry audit, not nominal seat width alone
assets.mass_basis: Static fixed assembly; no dynamic mass/inertia used
assets.collision_representation: Separate static triangle meshes copied from source solids; internal empty channel retained
assets.material_contact_basis: Current task physics configuration overrides authored engineering friction/contact assumptions; not physically calibrated

assets.datum: Legacy authored robot root; runtime world metre semantics preserved without additional automatic metadata scaling
assets.transform_basis: Legacy file has centimetre metadata and explicit geometry scales; replacement robot requires size/frame verification
assets.mass_basis: Per-link authored properties/defaults inherited from legacy robot; real masses/COM/inertia not independently verified
assets.collision_representation: Legacy per-link collision meshes; runtime articulation/drive/contact configuration applied by task
assets.material_contact_basis: Current runtime configuration; finger friction assumptions and phase force limits are not real calibration
